result.summary: The image shows a mixed-use urban street with marked continental crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. Pedestrian safety is compromised by visual obstructions from parked vehicles and a lack of traffic control signals or signage at the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban street with a marked zebra crosswalk and curb ramps featuring tactile warning pads. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the environment lacks signalization and contains visual obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line, particularly on the left side, may obstruct the line of sight between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway adjacent to the crosswalk markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position for drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban residential street with continuous sidewalks and curb ramps featuring tactile paving.
